nodes.description: Public token name string stored in contract storage.
Public token symbol string stored in contract storage.
Public number of decimals used for display purposes.
Public total token supply, set once at construction time.
Mapping of address to token balance; mutated by _transfer.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved amount.
Constructor setting metadata and minting totalSupply to msg.sender.
External transfer of tokens from msg.sender to _to with balance require check.
Internal helper performing balance mutations and emitting Transfer.
External approval allowing _spender to spend _value on behalf of msg.sender.
External transferFrom that checks balance and allowance then delegates to _transfer.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, sender and allowance spender key.
Arithmetic mutation balanceOf[_from] = balanceOf[_from] - _value inside _transfer.
Arithmetic mutation balanceOf[_to] = balanceOf[_to] + _value inside _transfer.
Arithmetic mutation allowance[_from][msg.sender] = allowance[_from][msg.sender] - _value inside transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read in the constructor to credit the whole totalSupply to the deployer.
transfer reads balanceOf[msg.sender] as the authoritative sender balance.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller identity.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the approved spender key in the allowance check.
allowance subtraction is indexed by msg.sender, so caller identity controls the mutated slot.
Constructor parameter _name flows into the name state variable.
Constructor parameter _symbol flows into the symbol state variable.
Constructor parameter _decimals flows into the decimals state variable.
Constructor parameter _totalSupply flows into totalSupply and balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor assigns _name to the name state variable.
Constructor assigns _symbol to the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns _decimals to the decimals state variable.
Constructor assigns _totalSupply to the totalSupply state variable.
Constructor writes the initial minted balance into balanceOf[msg.sender].
transfer forwards its _to parameter into the internal transfer call.
transfer compares and forwards its _value parameter.
transfer invokes the internal _transfer helper after the balance require check.
transferFrom invokes the internal _transfer helper after allowance checks.
balanceOf[_from] is read as the left operand of the subtraction in _transfer.
Result of balanceOf[_from] - _value is written back to balanceOf[_from].
_transfer._from selects which balance slot is decremented.
_transfer._value is the subtrahend in the balanceOf[_from] subtraction.
balanceOf[_to] is read as the left operand of the addition in _transfer.
Result of balanceOf[_to] + _value is written back to balanceOf[_to].
_transfer._to selects which balance slot is incremented.
_transfer._value is the addend in the balanceOf[_to] addition.
transfer passes its _value into _transfer where the balance arithmetic occurs.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read as the left operand of the transferFrom subtraction.
Result of allowance[_from][msg.sender] - _value is written back to the allowance mapping.
transferFrom._value is the subtrahend in the allowance decrement.
approve._spender is used as the allowance mapping key and zero-address check.
approve._value is stored into allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve writes the new allowance amount into the allowance state variable.
transferFrom._from is checked against balanceOf and allowance and passed to _transfer.
transferFrom._to is forwarded to the internal _transfer call.
transferFrom._value is compared against balance and allowance before the transfer.
transferFrom passes _from into _transfer, deciding which balance is debited.
transferFrom passes _to into _transfer, deciding which balance is credited.
